description: This source file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure OrchardCore services, including tenant isolation, static files, metrics, routing, authentication, data protection, and other middleware components.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure OrchardCore services and tenant isolation.

methods.name: AddOrchardCore
methods.description: Adds OrchardCore services to the IServiceCollection, with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddDefaultServices
methods.description: Configures default services for OrchardCore, including localization, logging, and core interfaces.

methods.name: AddShellServices
methods.description: Adds shell-related services, including primary and default features, release management, and feature validation.

methods.name: AddExtensionServices
methods.description: Adds extension management and module provider services.

methods.name: AddStaticFiles
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific static file providers and middleware for serving static content.

methods.name: AddMetrics
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific metrics services, isolating them from the host.

methods.name: AddRouting
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific routing services to isolate route configurations per tenant.

methods.name: IsolateHttpClient
methods.description: Isolates HTTP client singleton services and configurations per tenant.

methods.name: AddEndpointsApiExplorer
methods.description: Configures API explorer services at the tenant level.

methods.name: AddAntiForgery
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific antiforgery services with tenant-aware cookies.

methods.name: AddSameSiteCookieBackwardsCompatibility
methods.description: Adds support for backwards compatibility in SameSite cookie handling.

methods.name: CheckSameSiteBackwardsCompatibility
methods.description: Checks user agent to adjust SameSite cookie policy for compatibility.

methods.name: AddAuthentication
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific authentication services and middleware.

methods.name: AddDataProtection
methods.description: Configures tenant-specific data protection services with isolated key storage.
